R2.4 alignment grid, one parameter at a time around the published setting (n_neighbors 15, min_dist 0.1, align_dim 10, min_cluster_size 3, min_samples = min_cluster_size, max_cluster_size 100). Median [min, max] over 10 UMAP seeds. Agreement is on units non-noise in both groupings (matching.pair_scores); noise Jaccard beside it. Drift: WS1 locked statistic, B=100000. rho = Spearman over all published tested groups whose best-overlap match is tested in the variant.
